user_question: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College borough boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a candidate polygon boundary for State College borough to identify intersecting census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the available State College borough boundary dataset. The returned candidate must be evaluated at runtime for spatial coverage and supported format before downstream use.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundary to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the retrieved borough boundary into EPSG:26918 so it can participate in a binary spatial intersection with the census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the borough boundary to EPSG:26918. Do not assign a CRS or infer one; use the candidate's observed source CRS.

workflow_steps.title: Select census tract areas intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Create tract-zone geometries for the portions of census tracts that intersect State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform an intersection overlay between the census tract layer and the reprojected State College borough boundary. Preserve the census tract identifier attributes needed to report zonal statistics by tract. Do not repair or reproject inputs automatically.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject elevation raster to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the elevation raster to EPSG:26918 so it matches the intersecting tract-zone CRS for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the elevation GeoTIFF from its observed CRS to EPSG:26918. Preserve elevation values and use an appropriate raster reprojection method without inventing missing metadata.

workflow_steps.title: Compute mean elevation for intersecting census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate mean elevation from the raster within each tract zone intersecting State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal mean elevation using the reprojected elevation raster and the intersecting tract polygons. Use the observed census tract identifier field from runtime schema evidence to identify output rows; do not guess or fabricate field names.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve elevation raster with tract coverage
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain an available GeoTIFF elevation candidate whose spatial coverage is suitable for the census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve an available elevation GeoTIFF candidate for the State College census-tract area. Evaluate the returned candidate at runtime for spatial coverage, CRS metadata, and supported format before downstream use.
